title: The Description of a Far Cousin
youtube_title: The Description of a Far Cousin | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A story belongs to the person still speaking it.
summary: At a library window seat, the ferryman begins to tell Nim about description of a cousin you had not met. Nim wants to interrupt with bigger news, but listens all the way to the last sentence, asks one real question, and only then shares something small of their own.
